question: The Ugadi festival in India celebrates the_______
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​commencement of new year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Ugadi festival in India is celebrated to mark** the commencement of the New Year according to the Hindu lunar calendar.**
 
• **Ugadi** is a significant festival celebrated by people in the Deccan region of India, including the states of Karnat
